resources.string: Lets a trusted, paired Mac move the pointer and tap on this phone over Bridgey\'s existing encrypted connection. Only used while KVM Input is turned on in Bridgey\'s settings; does not read screen content.

Keep your Mac and phone on the same local network. Choose the Mac, compare the pairing code, then confirm it on both devices. Optional permissions are requested only when you enable the related feature.
Experimental: reads the page open in your browser (text, element ids, link targets; never password fields) so you can continue reading it on your Mac. Nothing is sent unless you trigger a handoff.
